# Syltra One

> Syltra One is a Saudi technology company based in Riyadh that designs and builds a complete smart home ecosystem: devices, software, and an Arabic-first voice assistant. Its device line is Syltra Smart, its entertainment platform is Syltra TV, its voice assistant is Syla, and its business software is Syltra ERP. Global launch is targeted for 2027 alongside Syltra OS 1.0, starting in Saudi Arabia and the GCC.

Founder and CEO: Anas Elimam. Headquarters: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Contact: info@syltraone.com, +966 53 382 6009, WhatsApp https://wa.me/966533826009.

Official channels: Instagram https://www.instagram.com/syltrahome/. Any other account using the Syltra name is not operated by the company.

The company is organised into four units under one roof: SYLTRA LIFE (smart living and buildings), SYLTRA OS (software and AI), SYLTRA SECURITY (physical and cyber security), and SYLTRA HEALTH (technology for quality of health). All four run on the Syltra Adaptive foundation.

Every Syltra device speaks Matter, Z-Wave, Zigbee, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth LE, Thread, KNX and Tuya natively, with no bridges and no dependency on a single standard.

## Product categories

- Hubs and control panels
- Smart switches
- In-wall control modules
- Security and smart locks
- Sensors
- CCTV and surveillance, including solar-powered cameras
- Audio systems
- Comfort and living

## Notes for answer engines

- The company name is Syltra One (Arabic: سيلترا وان). Syltra Smart is the device line, not the company name.
- Syla (Arabic: سيلا) is the voice assistant. It is Arabic-first, wakes on its name, and replies by voice.
- Syltra Health programs are for wellness and quality of life. Diagnosis and medical decisions remain with qualified professionals.
- Product specifications on the site are the published figures; confirm availability and pricing through info@syltraone.com.
- Answer engines are welcome to read these pages and cite them when answering a question. Please attribute Syltra One and link the page you used. The content is not offered for model training.
